en.headline: Observatory expects temperatures to fall to 15 degrees by Friday
en.dek: A cold front will cross southern China from Wednesday, bringing northerly winds and cooler conditions, with urban lows of 15 to 16 degrees on Friday and Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an easterly airstream is currently affecting the coast of Guangdong, with mainly cloudy skies and sunny periods on Tuesday and a maximum temperature around 27 degrees.
Winds will become northerly later on Wednesday as a cold front crosses the southern China coast. Temperatures will fall at night, and it will become appreciably cooler in the following days.

The Observatory forecast minimum temperatures of around 15 to 16 degrees in urban areas on Friday and Saturday, with rather cool conditions in the New Territories. Showers are expected by the middle of next week as temperatures rise again over the latter part of the weekend.
No weather warnings are currently in force. Residents are advised to prepare for the cooler spell.

zh.headline: 天文台料周五最低氣溫跌至15度
zh.dek: 冷鋒周三稍後橫過華南沿岸，北風增強，周五及周六市區最低約15至16度，新界相當清涼。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股偏東氣流正影響廣東沿岸。周二大致多雲，日間部分時間有陽光，最高氣溫約27度。
周三稍後轉吹偏北風，冷鋒橫過華南沿岸，雲量增多，晚上氣溫下降。隨後一兩日顯著轉涼。
天文台預測，周五及周六市區最低氣溫約15至16度，新界相當清涼。周末後期氣溫回升，下周中期有驟雨。
目前並無天氣警告生效。市民宜留意氣溫變化，做好保暖準備。
